input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/rollup.ts

The weekly rollup job checks `isRollupDue` using `startOfWeek(now, user.timezone)`, which assumes the week starts on Monday, but doesn't correctly account for time zones or UTC boundary alignment when determining the first day of the week for users in eastern offsets like Sydney (+10/+11), causing rolls to miss the Monday window and trigger on Tuesday.
